text.tspan: For anyone juggling more than they admit.
Training update: sleep fixed more than any new
program did.
My trainer made me slow down the eccentric and
everything got harder in a useful way.
You cannot out-train a calendar you refuse to
defend.
— Parker
Writing it down so I do not forget.
Recovery is training, not a reward you earn
later.
I missed three days, then restarted without a
dramatic reboot speech.
Recovery is training, not a reward you earn
later.
Protein at breakfast made afternoon cravings
less dramatic.
Progress compound interest is real if you stop
resetting every January.
